claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_numeric
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants a flat bonus to damage rolls made with the weapon, but the current EffectAtom union has no persistent damage-roll modifier atom. `modify_roll_numeric` only covers d20 roll kinds, and `damage` represents dealt damage instances rather than a standing modifier to future weapon damage rolls.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item-bound weapon scoping for passive grants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bonus applies only to attacks and damage made with this specific magic weapon. Existing scoping can narrow by coarse weapon category (`melee` or `ranged`) or by broad wielding predicates, but cannot express 'this exact weapon item only' across both attack-roll and damage-roll modifiers.
